Here, <vacation_spot> is the name of the vacation spot as it appears in the sub-directory name.

import os
# Re-login to file_system using supervisor-stored credentials
creds = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
fs_pass = next(c['password'] for c in creds if c['account_name']=='file_system')
fs_email='adrian_burt@gmail.com'
login_resp = apis.file_system.login(username=fs_email, password=fs_pass)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

vac_root='~/pictures/vacations'
# Get direct vacation spot sub-directories
spots = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=vac_root, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print('spots', spots)

# Compress each spot directory into vacations/<spot>.zip, then delete the directory
results=[]
for spot_dir in spots:
    # spot_dir is absolute like /home/adrian/pictures/vacations/bali/
    spot = os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(spot_dir))
    target_zip = f"{vac_root}/{spot}.zip"
    # Check if zip exists to decide overwrite
    zip_exists_resp = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=access_token, file_path=target_zip)
    zip_exists = zip_exists_resp.get('exists', False)
    print('spot', spot, 'dir', spot_dir, 'zip', target_zip, 'zip_exists', zip_exists)

    comp_resp = apis.file_system.compress_directory(
        access_token=access_token,
        directory_path=spot_dir,
        compressed_file_path=target_zip,
        delete_directory=False,
        overwrite=zip_exists
    )
    print('compress_resp', comp_resp)
    results.append({'spot': spot, 'compress': comp_resp})

    del_resp = apis.file_system.delete_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=spot_dir)
    print('delete_resp', del_resp)

print('done')
print('results_count', len(results))
print('results', results)
